changes.now: Teenage Tony Stark builds his armor after his father's plane goes down, and fights Obadiah Stane and the Mandarin while hiding it from his classmates, with Rhodey and Pepper in on the secret. On the TVA's monitors, Earth-904913 is marked terminated.
changes.proposed: Teenage Tony Stark becomes Iron Man after his father's plane goes down, and fights Obadiah Stane and the Mandarin while hiding it from his classmates, with Rhodey and Pepper in on the secret. On the TVA's monitors, Earth-904913 is marked terminated.
changes.evidence: Tony did not build the armor after the crash: in the pilot he was already wearing the battle suit he had designed and built himself, and it kept him alive in the plane crash that Howard seemingly dies in. He becomes Iron Man after that, when the media names him.

changes.now: Loki and the Frost Giants threaten the holidays, and the Avengers step in to save them. On the TVA's monitors, Earth-TRN838 is marked terminated.
changes.proposed: Loki and the giant Ymir threaten the holidays, and the Avengers step in to save them. On the TVA's monitors, Earth-TRN838 is marked terminated.
changes.evidence: The film's villains are Loki and one ice giant, Ymir, who opens the Casket of Ancient Winters with him and then plans to steal Santa's power. The Frost Giants as a race are only mentioned, never shown as a group of villains.
